violation_type.title: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats (26 TAC §747.2303(4))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats
violation_type.typical_finding: The cots were arranged for naptime; however, there was no space between them, preventing the caregiver from walking between the cots.

finding_variants.text: The cots were arranged for naptime; however, there was no space between them, preventing the caregiver from walking between the cots.
